nodes.summary: Let $K$ and $L$ be fields with $L$ a $K$-algebra, let $v$ be a real-valued absolute value on $K$, and let $w$ be a real-valued absolute value on $L$ lying over $v$, that is, $w(x) = v(x)$ for every $x \in K$ viewed in $L$ through the algebra map. If $f$ is a monic polynomial over $K$ and $\alpha \in L$ is a root of $f$, then $w(\alpha)$ is strictly less than the L1 norm of $f$ with respect to $v$.
nodes.title: Root bound by the L1 norm

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a semiring and $v$ a real-valued absolute value on $K$. For every polynomial $p = \sum_i a_i X^i \in K[X]$, the L1 norm $\|p\|_v$ of $p$ with respect to $v$ equals $\sum_{i \in S} v(a_i)$, where $S = \{ i : a_i \neq 0 \}$ is the support of $p$.
nodes.title: L1 norm as a sum over the support

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nontrivial semiring (one with $0 \neq 1$) and $v$ a real-valued absolute value on $K$. If $f = \sum_i a_i X^i \in K[X]$ is monic of degree $n$, then the L1 norm of $f$ with respect to $v$ is $\|f\|_v = \sum_{i=0}^{n-1} v(a_i) + 1$.
nodes.title: L1 norm of a monic polynomial

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a semiring and $v$ a real-valued absolute value on $K$. Let $p = \sum_i a_i X^i \in K[X]$ and let $n$ be the degree of $p$, with $n = 0$ when $p = 0$. Then the L1 norm of $p$ with respect to $v$ is $\|p\|_v = \sum_{i=0}^{n} v(a_i)$.
nodes.title: L1 norm as a sum up to the degree

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a semiring and $v$ a real-valued absolute value on $K$. For every polynomial $p \in K[X]$, the L1 norm of $p$ with respect to $v$ satisfies $\|p\|_v \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Nonnegativity of the L1 norm

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a semiring and $v$ a real-valued absolute value on $K$. The L1 norm of the zero polynomial in $K[X]$ with respect to $v$ is $0$.
nodes.title: L1 norm of the zero polynomial

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a semiring and $v$ a real-valued absolute value on $K$. The L1 norm of a polynomial $p = \sum_i a_i X^i \in K[X]$ with respect to $v$ is the real number $\|p\|_v = \sum_i v(a_i)$, where the sum runs over the indices $i$ with $a_i \neq 0$.
nodes.title: L1 norm of a polynomial

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nontrivial ring and $v$ a real-valued absolute value on $K$. If $f, g \in K[x]$ are monic and the L1 norm of $f - g$ with respect to $v$ is strictly less than $1$, then $f$ and $g$ have the same degree.
nodes.title: Monic polynomials close in L1 norm have the same degree

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be a nontrivial semiring (one with $0 \neq 1$) and $v$ a real-valued absolute value on $K$. If $f \in K[X]$ is monic, then the L1 norm of $f$ with respect to $v$ satisfies $\|f\|_v \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Monic polynomials have L1 norm at least one
